overview: The Praetorian Barracks are home to Sanctus Seru’s elite enforcers, trained to uphold imperial doctrine and enforce the Tribunal’s edicts.
history: Constructed during the early rise of Seru’s authoritarian rule.
Arcane stabilizers were added to reinforce discipline chambers.
Praetorian training halls became the standard for elite enforcement.
The barracks expanded to support the Inquisitorial Quarter and Armory Bastion.
hooks: A Praetorian commander requests assistance investigating sabotage.
Arcane stabilizers pulse irregularly, threatening training operations.
A recruit disappears during discipline trials.
A sealed edict arrives from the Tribunal of Order.
